name: Slime World
author: VampX
description:
Slime World is a Pixel Action 2D Platformer. In the amazing world of Slime World you play as a slime and you try and overcome 10+ unique levels. The game is filled with lots of enemies, obstacles and much more. Controls: WASD, or Arrow keys. Space to Dash
